mainEntity.name: What kind of contractor should I look for to repair dry rot?

acceptedAnswer.text: When seeking a contractor for dry rot repair, look for companies with specific experience in structural timber repair, water damage restoration, and general construction. Ensure they are licensed and insured in California and have a proven track record in your service area. A contractor who offers comprehensive services from moisture source identification to full timber replacement and finishes will streamline the process. Check their references and project portfolio to ensure their expertise aligns with the scope of your dry rot issues.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for a licensed and insured contractor with experience in structural timber repair, water damage restoration, and general construction, ensuring they offer comprehensive services.
